notes: Adds API/control plane, revocation logic, and integration coverage to complete lifecycle management.

stories.title: Token Revocation Service
stories.description: Implement backend service to revoke bearer tokens by token_id or agent scope, updating revoked_flag and enforcing immediate denial on subsequent authentication attempts.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No revocation mechanism currently implemented

stories.title: Token Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose secure internal API endpoints for token lifecycle operations including create, rotate, revoke, and status check, restricted to authorized system actors.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/function_app.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No lifecycle management API exists

stories.title: Authentication Middleware Integration
stories.description: Integrate token lifecycle checks (expiration, rotation version, revocation) into GPTReader and Brain auth validation paths to ensure all requests enforce updated token policies.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop integration tests covering full token lifecycle including issuance, validation, rotation, expiration, revocation, and failure scenarios across GPTReader endpoints.

change_log.note: Completes lifecycle with explicit revocation capability
Ensures enforcement across all request paths
